body:
Scope check: this needs a new swept-footprint raster algorithm and per-move engagement-width measurement. AGENTS.md rates new algorithms as effort:max. The existing quality module measures engagement against dexel stock, but it does not provide the requested independent expected/swept mask comparison, leftover-location law, or difference PNG.

crates/motion has no PNG dependency. The existing PNG writer is in crates/app/src/raster.rs. Tests in motion cannot import app, and this task forbids dependency changes, so the implementation also needs a test-only PNG writer or an agreed alternative.

Escalated effort:high to effort:max under work-issue step 4. No claim was taken. No code or pinning test was written. No branch or worktree was created. The issue is free for the next worker. The initial checks found no blocking label, claim comment, existing mask helper on upstream/main, or open release PR. File-overlap queries found no open PR for AGENTS.md, crates/motion/tests/trochoid_slot.rs, crates/motion/tests/adaptive_hsm.rs, crates/motion/tests/shape_masks.rs, crates/motion/tests/common/shape_mask.rs, or docs/decisions/1768-shape-masks.md.
